newsitem.title: UK: BANKAMERICA NAMES EMERGING MARKET EUROBONDS HEAD.
newsitem.headline: BANKAMERICA NAMES EMERGING MARKET EUROBONDS HEAD.

text.p: Bank of America said it appointed Len Harwood to head eurobond origination and syndicate for global emerging markets trading in London.

Harwood, who will join the bank on August 26, will be responsible for building the bank's recently established capabilities in eurobond origination for emerging market issuers. He will report to Alexandra McLeod, head of global emerging markets trading.
"Len will provide the catalyst for Bank of America's growing role in the origination of eurobonds in the emerging markets business," McLeod said in a statement.
"He will focus initially on deals in the private sector using our extensive local market knowledge and contacts," she added.
